skipReasons: Pre-existing TestRunEndpoint in http_integration_test.go is gated behind E2E_RUNS=1 (requires Node/Playwright/cucumber-js in the environment); unrelated to this feature, left as-is

accessibilityCheck: Report links are native <a href> anchors, not onclick-only divs — keyboard reachable and activatable (TestRunsPage_ReportLinksAreKeyboardNavigable)
Each report link carries a distinguishing aria-label="View report for run <id>" so identical link text is still distinguishable via screen reader/tab order
Table headers use scope="col" and a visually-hidden <caption> names the table's purpose
Status is conveyed as plain text (running/passed/failed), not color alone

No axe/browser-based a11y tooling exists in this Go backend's test stack (Saturday's Playwright a11y checks apply to the TS/E2E layer, not this server-rendered page) — checks above were done by direct HTML assertion instead

notesForTechWriter: Document GET /api/runs: query params status, cursor, limit (default 20, max 100); response envelope { runs: [...], nextCursor? }; a cursor past the end returns 200 with an empty runs array; a cursor that fails to decode returns 400.

Document GET /runs console page: same query params (status, cursor); table columns ID/Status/Started/Duration/Report; in-progress runs render 'running' with no report link; the 'Next page' link preserves the active status filter and HTML-entity-escapes the joining '&'.
Flag that both endpoints are currently unauthenticated, consistent with the rest of the console API today — a known, tracked gap (see security-report.md), not new scope creep from this feature.
